title: [Decision] How should an MCP agent find a colleague (by name or email) to fill a person field or route work, when sys_user is not exposed over MCP?
body:
Filing category: ② a decision only the maintainer can make.

## 维护者速读

- 现象：MCP agent 无法把一个人（按姓名或邮箱）解析成环境里的用户 id。`sys_user` 是系统对象，`query_records` 直接拒绝（"is a system object and is not exposed via MCP"）。所以 agent 不能往「员工 / 审批人 / 负责人」这类 `user` 字段填任何别人，只能等当事人自己建记录、再从 `owner_id` 里抄 id。托管环境里 cloud 账号 id 和环境里的用户 id 还不是同一个，agent 手里的 id 也用不上。
- 要你裁：MCP 是否提供「找人」的能力，以及形状。
- 推荐：A：只读的「人员查找」，按姓名/邮箱前缀返回 id + 显示名（受调用者自己的可见范围约束），不开放 `sys_user` 整表。

## One-sentence problem

"Create Zhang San's leave balance" or "assign this request to Li Si" cannot be done by an agent, because it has no way to find out who Zhang San is.

## Evidence (reach)

Hosted tenant (`pnpm dev:stack`, Team plan; cloud `ff373e02`, framework `d7c3d44e`), MCP OAuth token of the organization owner:
- `query_records { objectName: 'sys_user', where: { email: '<member email>' } }` → `Object "sys_user" is a system object and is not exposed via MCP` (same for a plain member).
- `create_record rtbw_leave_bal { employee: '<the member's cloud user id>' }` → `员工: no sys_user record has id "…"` — the id the control plane knows is not the environment's user id (the member signed in through OIDC and got an environment user `MgyoX3…`).
- Workaround used in the test: the member created a request themselves; the owner read its `owner_id`.

## Governing text

- `packages/mcp/README.md` — "`sys_*` objects hidden by default" (`list_objects`), "`sys_*`-object actions are held back fail-closed".
- `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` — agents through MCP are one of the two kinds of user; "approvals and automation", "sign-in and identity" are on the road.
- Rule 14c (served by `get_authoring_rules`) — approvers by `field` name "a user lookup field on the record", which an agent cannot fill for anyone but itself.

## Options

| Option | What it does | What the customer sees | Effort |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | A read-only people lookup on the MCP data surface (e.g. `find_people { query }` → `{ id, name, email? }`), scoped by what the caller may already see of members | Agents fill person fields and route work by name | mcp seat · 1 PR · no precedent |
| B | Expose `sys_user` read-only through the record tools under FLS (name/email only) | Same, through `query_records` | mcp + security seats · 1–2 PRs · no precedent |
| C | Keep people invisible to agents; document that person fields are filled by people | Agents leave every person field empty | none |

Business reading: A = agents can say "this is for Zhang San" like a colleague would; B = the same, by opening a system table; C = agents only ever act on their own records.

## Recommendation

A. Two years out an agent on a business app routes and assigns work by name (Salesforce/ServiceNow agents resolve users through a scoped lookup, not by opening the user table). A keeps the system object closed and adds one narrow, read-only tool. Confidence gap: whether member email should be visible to every member (privacy) — the tool can return name + id only by default.
Self-check: only ① picks A; ②③④ do not flip it.

## After the ruling

A: `packages/mcp` adds the tool under `data:read`, scoped through the same identity read the console's people picker uses; a test asserting it never returns a member outside the caller's organization.

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性: A 用一个窄的只读工具补上 agent 的「找人」，不打开 `sys_user` 整表，特例最小。
② 实际业务拉动: 任何带人员字段的流程（请假余额归属、审批人、负责人分配）今天都卡在这一步（本次实测）。
③ 防 AI 犯错: 现状 agent 只能猜 id 或把字段留空；A 让它拿到真实 id，写错时被响亮拒绝而不是静默留空。
④ 创业阶段不扩散: A 新增一个工具（永久义务）；C 零成本但让人员字段对 agent 不可用。
Prior rulings read: "mcp sys_user lookup person user field" → 65 hits (top: #3146, #31350, #24952; none on MCP people lookup); ADR-0101; thread: none

Reader who acts: the `packages/mcp` seat, after the ruling.
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue mcp sys_user lookup person user field` → 65 hits, none proposes an MCP people lookup.
